items.title: Why eBay (EBAY) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) fell 4.7% in the afternoon session after an analyst downgrade from Wells Fargo, which lowered its rating on the company to Underweight from Equal Weight. The bank also significantly cut its price target for eBay to $92 from $105. Wells Fargo's decision stemmed from concerns that eBay will need to increase marketing spending for its recently acquired Depop platform to defend against a new competitor, Vinted, which is entering the U.S. market.
